finalResult.nextParagraphText: Jake was about to make a move as Artemis held a finger up. “Not now, though. finalResult.previousParagraphText: Logically, Jake knew Artemis was saying it for pragmatic reasons due to how Records worked and whatnot, but it still made him smile goofily. The wood elf goddess noticed his facial expression and chuckled.
